package nextbestaction

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"testing"
)

type ownerReader struct {
	value domain.TeacherNextAction
	err   error
	calls int
}

func (r *ownerReader) GetNextAction(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherNextAction, error) {
	r.calls++
	return r.value, r.err
}

func TestGetPreservesAuthoritativeStudentDecision(t *testing.T) {
	r := &ownerReader{value: domain.TeacherNextAction{Schema: "student-next-action.v1", PolicyVersion: "student-next-action-policy.v1", Status: "WAITING", ReasonCode: "validation_running", SecondaryActions: []domain.NextActionChoice{}, SourceVersions: domain.TeacherNextActionSourceVersions{ContextVersion: 3, PathVersion: 7, StateDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"}}}
	got, err := (Get{Enabled: true, Actions: r}).Execute(context.Background(), "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, r.value, got)
	require.Equal(t, 1, r.calls)
}
func TestGetNeverFallsBackToTeacherDecision(t *testing.T) {
	r := &ownerReader{err: errors.New("owner unavailable")}
	_, err := (Get{Enabled: true, Actions: r}).Execute(context.Background(), "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrNextBestActionStateUnavailable)
	_, err = (Get{Actions: r}).Execute(context.Background(), "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrNextBestActionDisabled)
	require.Equal(t, 1, r.calls)
}
